purpose: Turn a user work request into a bounded AgentSwitchboard sprint only after fleet readiness, target repository safety, prompt, and provider gates are observed.
inputs: bounded sprint prompt or prompt path
preconditions: bootstrap-or-list-readiness workflow classified fleet as installed
requested adapter is READY/adapter-ready or explicitly verification-required with a launch-time probe
target repository checkout satisfies the GNHF cleanliness contract
prompt is explicit for non-AgentSwitchboard repositories

steps.name: verify target repository
steps.action: Resolve exact local path, repository identity, current branch/status, and nearest rules. Preserve unrelated dirty work; do not reset or stash automatically.

steps.name: select agent from observed readiness
steps.action: Choose only an adapter present in current readiness output. Do not infer readiness from tool installation or an earlier chat.

steps.name: freeze bounded sprint
steps.action: Record mission, owned scope, forbidden scope, expected artifacts, validation, iteration/token bounds, StopWhen, proof ceiling, and push behavior.

steps.name: validate prompt source
steps.action: For AgentSwitchboard, a bundled role prompt may be used. For every other repository, require -Prompt or -PromptPath so a repository-specific work order is explicit.

steps.name: respect provider boundary
steps.action: If the route is verification-required, preserve interactive authentication/model/quota/spawnability checks. Adapter readiness is not hosted-response proof.

steps.name: launch bounded sprint
steps.action: Invoke installed agent-switchboard.cmd with RepoPath, Agent, Prompt/PromptPath, Name, MaxIterations, MaxTokens, StopWhen, and PushBranch only when explicitly intended.

steps.name: resolve output
steps.action: Read launcher summary, generated GNHF worktree/branch status, commit, validation evidence, and provider-route proof when applicable.

steps.name: handoff
steps.action: Use handoff-agent-task workflow. Report what changed, proof earned, remaining gaps, preserved work, and the next executable gate.

forbidden: launching work because tmux is live while fleet state is unproved
launching a blocked or unknown adapter
using AgentSwitchboard bundled prompts against another repository without an explicit work prompt
automatic force-push, merge, deployment, or reset of user work
claiming provider success from adapter readiness alone
proofCeiling: Defines a safe sprint-launch sequence. A completed sprint still requires actual launcher, worktree, commit, validation, and provider evidence before higher proof can be claimed.
